abstract: Maintains satellite telemetry links and deep-field navigation infrastructure
system_message:
You are the Communications and navigation lead (COMMS), responsible for maintaining satellite telemetry links and deep-field navigation infrastructure for polar research logistics and field operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Differential navigation calibration（GNSS）
information_points.content:
COMMS-GNSS-1T8：During a 24-hour static calibration beacon run audited at the differential base station, the High-flotation multi-axle wheeled convoy recorded a maximum horizontal position drift of 0.08 m from the true survey coordinate.
COMMS-GNSS-FPD：During a 24-hour static calibration beacon run audited at the differential base station, the Heavy articulated tracked traverse train demonstrated a maximum horizontal position drift of 0.04 m from the true survey coordinate.
COMMS-GNSS-SQ0：During a 24-hour static calibration beacon run audited at the differential base station, the Segmented dual-track modular hauler recorded a maximum horizontal position drift of 0.12 m from the true survey coordinate.

information_points.title: Maintains satellite telemetry links and deep-field navigation infrastructure（NAV）
information_points.content:
COMMS-NAV-U05：For the Segmented dual-track modular hauler, bench testing of the primary polar satellite tracking terminal confirmed that the autonomous satellite telemetry uplink is verified for continuous bi-directional transmission at latitudes above 75 degS.
COMMS-NAV-FWQ：For the Heavy articulated tracked traverse train, bench testing of the primary polar satellite tracking terminal confirmed that the autonomous satellite telemetry uplink is verified for continuous bi-directional transmission at latitudes above 75 degS.
COMMS-NAV-X6D：For the High-flotation multi-axle wheeled convoy, bench testing of the primary polar satellite tracking terminal indicated that the autonomous satellite telemetry uplink is not verified for continuous bi-directional transmission at latitudes above 75 degS.
